teaser: Two apps about what an agent can reach, built in a day: José Bota's Hack the Agent and ReachCheck, used, tested and reviewed.
core_idea: José Bota built two apps at the Vibathon: Hack the Agent, a multiplayer prompt-injection game whose five levels add defences until the lesson is that any rule only the model enforces can be argued with; and ReachCheck, a browser-only review that compares an agent's configuration with its owner's mandate, honest about its limits but so cautious it missed obvious risks in an invented configuration; both are well made, and both point to turning lessons and mandates into behaviour policies.
